scenes.display: A fanless industrial computer, built on Raspberry Pi CM5.
scenes.text: Meet the IRIV SmartHub. A fanless industrial computer, built on the Raspberry Pi Compute Module five.
It computes, connects and displays, all from one compact metal box.

segments.text: At the shop counter, every barcode scan lands on the cashier screen.
The customer display shows the total, and the receipt prints.
Each sale updates the stock, and low items are reordered.

scenes.display: Gigabit Ethernet, USB 2.0, two HDMI ports and two ways to power it.
scenes.text: Around the back: network, USB, two displays and power.
Gigabit Ethernet connects the shop or plant network.

scenes.display: For devices that stay plugged in.
scenes.text: Two USB 2.0 ports take a scanner, a printer or a keyboard.

scenes.display: Two full-size HDMI 2.0 ports, each up to 4K at 60 Hz.
scenes.text: Two full size HDMI ports drive two screens, each up to 4K at sixty hertz.

scenes.display: One USB-C port for power and for reflashing.
scenes.text: USB C powers the unit, and reflashes the operating system.

scenes.display: DC barrel jack, 10 to 30 V, surge protected.
scenes.text: Or power it from ten to thirty volts, with surge protection.

scenes.display: Fast ports for cameras and storage.
scenes.text: On the front, two USB 3 ports for cameras and fast storage.

scenes.display: A power button and a programmable USER button.
scenes.text: A power button, and a user button you can program.

scenes.display: Power, activity and M.2 lights, plus two programmable LEDs.
scenes.text: Status lights show power, activity and storage, plus two that you control.

scenes.display: Dual-band Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.0. Antenna included.
scenes.text: Dual band Wi Fi and Bluetooth are built in. The antenna is included.

scenes.display: A mini PCIe socket (USB 2.0 only) with a SIM slot.
scenes.text: An expansion socket and a SIM slot add a 4G modem.
For digital signage, one SmartHub drives two screens, around the clock.
On the factory floor, it tracks every job, live from the machines.
Inside: a quad core processor, up to sixteen gigabytes of memory, and room for an N V M E drive.

scenes.display: 147 × 94 × 35.7 mm. No fan, no moving parts.
scenes.text: The fanless metal case screws flat to a wall or a panel.

scenes.display: Uptime recorded in Cytron’s own long-run test.
scenes.text: In Cytron's own test, a SmartHub ran for eighty four days without a restart.
Explore the ports and compatible parts in the interactive demo, and build your own system.
